thought.text: Dua domain hidup. Saya lihat isinya.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && for d in lightvela.com lightvela.ai; do echo "=== $d ==="; curl -s --max-time 25 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://$d" | python3 -c "
import sys,re,html
s=sys.stdin.read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s)); t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t)
print(t[:700])
"; done
